scope: Native in-process MCP with real retained gopls; one independent warm cohort of 20 measured operations per scenario and policy, after calibration. Setup, metrics retrieval and final verification excluded from timing.

policy.before: Buffered AST mutation observers eagerly synchronize retained sessions.
policy.after: Buffered observers defer to the retained-session query boundary or publication. Private stage start/drop/abort skip the outer disk observer; commit retains publication synchronization. Same-content dirty-to-published notifications and preserved-metadata save fallback remain.

validation.benchmark_oracles: Existing benchmark validates actual source edits, final clean diagnostics and a single gopls process per cohort.
